# Cincy Crash Data
```{r cincy_crashes}
crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day

# adds the columns in crashes by day
crashes_by_day = c(2020L, 2241L, 2327L, 2285L,
                   2380L, 1866L, 1664L)
# adds names to the columns in vector - like a dictionary
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day

# checks for each item in the vector - returns a value for each day
crashes_by_day > 2100
```

## Type of `crashes_by_day`
```{r typeof_vec}
typeof(TRUE)     # logical
typeof(401L)     # integer: the L
typeof(401)      # double: no L
typeof("401")    # character: quotes

typeof(crashes_by_day)  # integers
```
